title: FistWorld Main Theme
feedback: Calm and unobtrusive is good, but too long to get started and a little dark.

title: FistWorld Village Theme
feedback: Too much like a children's lullaby; needs atmosphere and some quiet grandeur.

title: FistWorld Theme
direction: Immediate motif, warmer major/suspended harmony, lute, low strings and a light pulse.
feedback: Too jolly, still felt like a children's game.

title: Sunlit Grasslands Of FistWorld
direction: Longer atmospheric folk score with low strings, lute, subtle drum and distant horn colour.
feedback: Reset away from jolly folk and repetitive two-note accompaniment.
